dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - August 04, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Dominant Performances Highlight MLB Action**

A trio of long homers highlighted the day's action as Tyler O'Neill (8) and Wilyer Abreu (19) each went deep in their teams' losses. O'Neill's fly ball to left center field proved the difference in the Orioles' 3-1 win over the Angels, while Abreu's two-homer effort was not enough to lift the Athletics past the Reds. The Red Sox, meanwhile, exploded for 14 runs in a 14-2 rout of the White Sox.

On the mound, Ryan Weathers tossed six shutout innings with six strikeouts in the Yankees' 2-0 win over the Cardinals. Logan Henderson allowed two runs over six innings with eight strikeouts in the Brewers' 4-2 victory over the Pirates. Jesús Luzardo and Hayden Wesneski each threw complete-game shutouts in their teams' wins over the Nationals and Blue Jays, respectively.
